name: Ofeibea Strand-Quesada
role: Street doc and unlicensed trauma surgeon operating out of a converted shipping container in The Narrows
location: The Narrows — Blackpipe Corridor, Container Row 7, near Fullerton and Damen
description:
Ofeibea is a broad-shouldered woman with close-cropped silver-threaded locs and deep brown skin mapped with old surgical scars on both forearms — the kind you get from learning on the job rather than a simulator. Her left eye is a pale surgical prosthetic, off-brand Helix issue, that sometimes lags a half-second behind her right when she blinks. She wears a permanently stained canvas apron over layered thermal underlayers, and her hands are always immaculately clean no matter what the rest of her looks like. She speaks with a blunt, exhausted authority that makes people feel safe and slightly afraid at the same time.

She ran a legitimate trauma practice at Aurochs Medical Complex for eleven years before her license was pulled in a billing dispute that she insists — credibly — was a setup by a Helix Biosystems administrator she refused to bribe. Now she stitches up stabbing victims, sets broken bones, and removes black-market cyberware for whoever can pay in Quanta or barter. She has a fierce, almost maternal protectiveness over her regulars, and a cold professionalism toward everyone else. She prays daily to a small E.L.F. she calls Catgut that has allegedly inhabited her surgical lamp for six years.

core_fears: Losing her hands to injury or disease
Watching someone die from something she could have prevented with proper equipment
core_desires: To practice medicine without bureaucratic interference
To prove Helix Biosystems wrong about her
coping_mechanisms: Ritual — always washes hands three times before any procedure
Compartmentalization — does not name patients she thinks won't survive
blind_spots: Underestimates how much her bitterness about Aurochs affects her judgment toward corporate patients
psychology.secret: She still has her Aurochs Medical Complex login credentials, given to her by a sympathetic sysadmin who felt guilty. She uses them occasionally to access drug databases and surgical literature, which is technically a criminal offense.

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Clinical precision mixed with Narrows street vernacular. Uses medical jargon unselfconsciously, then immediately translates it without condescension.
speech_patterns.cadence: Measured and deliberate. Rarely rushes. Every sentence sounds like a diagnosis.
verbal_tics: 'That's what it is.' — used to close a subject
Clicks her tongue before delivering bad news
example_lines: You've got a grade-three laceration and something that should not be vibrating. Sit down. That's what it is.
I don't ask where it came from. You shouldn't ask where it's going. We both go home.

story_hooks: A patient dies on her table from augmentation failure and the device has a Helix serial number — the same administrator who destroyed her career oversees that product line.
She asks a player character to retrieve a specific surgical tool stolen from her container, which turns out to be the only copy of a custom instrument she designed herself.
narrative_function: Quest giver, information source about the underworld of unlicensed medicine, emergency resource for injured characters, moral anchor in rough neighborhoods. Can provide healing and removal of illegal augmentations.
augmentations: Left eye prosthetic (Helix off-brand, surgical magnification capable). Basic haptic feedback implants in both hands for surgical precision. No cosmetic mods.
daily_life: Opens her container at 0700, sees walk-ins until noon, performs any scheduled procedures in the afternoon, closes at midnight unless someone's bleeding. Sleeps four to six hours on a cot behind a curtain.
affiliation: Independent — loose ties to the Blackpipe Community Health Cooperative

decision_rules: Triage by severity, not ability to pay
Never operate while impaired, no exceptions
Don't treat anyone who has harmed her regulars
escalation_ladder: Physical removal from the premises if necessary — she is stronger than she looks

interpersonal_modes.strangers: Cool and professional. Gets to the medical issue immediately. No small talk until trust is established.
interpersonal_modes.friends: Warm in a gruff way. Expresses care through practical acts — remembering allergies, checking in without being asked.

stress_responses.medium: Begins issuing rapid, clipped instructions to anyone nearby
stress_responses.high: Enters a focused trance-like state; completely silent except for essential commands

contradictions: Professes to not care about her reputation, but keeps a folder of anonymous positive reviews she's received on underground med forums
habits: Wipes her instruments in a specific order after every procedure
Leaves a drop of saline on the E.L.F. lamp each morning as an offering to Catgut
breaking_points: A child brought in who clearly could have been saved earlier with proper care

timeline.event: Born in Grainfort district to a Ghanaian-descended dock worker and a Peruvian-descended logistics clerk
Completed medical degree through Helix Biosystems sponsored education program — a debt she's still technically paying
Joined Aurochs Medical Complex trauma unit, rose to senior trauma surgeon within four years
License revoked following fabricated billing fraud charge; lost her apartment and her savings in the legal battle
Opened the container clinic in Blackpipe Corridor with equipment sourced from medical waste auctions and personal favors

related_entities: Zheng-Dao Heavy Industries Space Elevator Tether System

physical_description.build: Broad-shouldered and thick through the torso, muscular without being athletic — the build of someone who stands for twelve hours at a time and moves with deliberate economy. Her frame carries the weight of two decades of physical labor.
physical_description.hair_color: Deep black with silver threading throughout
physical_description.hair_style: Close-cropped locs, tightly maintained, approximately 5-7cm length
physical_description.eye_color: Right eye: deep brown. Left eye: pale surgical prosthetic with faint Helix Biosystems branding visible at the iris edge, occasionally catching light with a subtle lag
physical_description.skin_tone: Deep warm brown with rich undertones, sun-weathered around the eyes and neck
physical_description.complexion: Strong facial structure, high cheekbones, broad nose. Skin is weathered but meticulously maintained. Fine creases around the eyes and mouth from exhaustion and concentration. No makeup. Expression defaults to attentive and slightly stern.
distinguishing_marks: Bilateral surgical scarring on both forearms — dense, pale, crisscrossing patterns from the wrist to mid-forearm, evidence of repeated subcutaneous work and self-teaching
Thin white scar running from left temple to cheekbone, approximately 4cm, barely visible unless light catches it
Callused fingertips and hardened palms, particularly pronounced on right hand
physical_description.visible_augmentations: Left eye prosthetic with slight luminescence and magnification capability. Faint subdermal patterning visible on the back of both hands under certain lighting — haptic feedback implant interfaces. Hands are noticeably cleaner than the rest of her appearance, suggesting obsessive post-procedure hygiene.
physical_description.posture_movement: Stands with weight distributed evenly, shoulders slightly forward from years hunched over surgical tables. Moves with controlled precision — no wasted motion. Hands are steady and deliberate. When focusing, her left eye occasionally halts a fraction of a second behind her right, a tell she's learned to live with. Overall bearing conveys exhausted authority.
physical_description.clothing_style: Permanently stained canvas surgical apron (originally grey, now mottled with old bloodstains and disinfectant bleaching) worn over layered thermal underlayers in dark greys and blacks. Beneath: practical cargo pants with reinforced pockets, black polymer boots with non-slip soles. No jewelry except a worn metal ring on her right ring finger — possibly a wedding band, worn smooth. Clothing is Tier 4 practical — function over aesthetics, maintained but not pristine. The apron is the only distinctive element, marking her role immediately.

image_prompt: A 47-year-old woman with deep brown skin and close-cropped silver-threaded locs, broad shoulders and weathered features, standing in harsh container-clinic lighting. Her left eye is a pale surgical prosthetic with faint Helix branding, her right eye deep brown and steady. Deep surgical scars map both forearms. She wears a permanently stained grey canvas apron over dark thermal layers and cargo pants, hands immaculately clean and steady. Behind her: a converted shipping container clinic with surgical lamps and worn equipment. Exhausted authority, clinical precision, slight fear in her presence.
